# LEAPPs

> Free, open-source digital forensics tools for practitioners worldwide. The LEAPP family parses logs, events, plists, and app data from iOS, Android, ISP warrant returns, vehicle systems and desktop applications, and triages images and video, producing readable reports plus LAVA projects for interactive review. Created by Alexis Brignoni and maintained by a global community.

## Tools

- [iLEAPP](https://github.com/abrignoni/iLEAPP): iOS/iPadOS Logs, Events, and Plists Parser — parses iTunes backups and full file system extractions
- [ALEAPP](https://github.com/abrignoni/ALEAPP): Android Logs, Events, and Protobuf Parser — parses adb backups and full file system extractions
- [RLEAPP](https://github.com/abrignoni/RLEAPP): Returns, Logs, Events, and Properties Parser — parses ISP/provider warrant returns (Google, Meta, Snap, and more)
- [VLEAPP](https://github.com/abrignoni/VLEAPP): Vehicle Logs, Events, and Properties Parser — parses vehicle system extractions
- [DLEAPP](https://github.com/abrignoni/DLEAPP): Desktop Logs, Events, and Protobuf Parser — desktop application artifacts (Electron, Chromium) plus any artifact that doesn't fit the platform-specific tools; prebuilt packages for Windows, macOS, and Linux
- [GLEAPP](https://github.com/abrignoni/GLEAPP): Graphics, Logs, Examination, Automated Processing, Parsing — image and video triage: hashing, de-duplication, metadata, video key frames, known-hash matching, and a local review gallery; prebuilt packages for Windows, macOS, and Linux
- [GLEAPP Map Downloader](https://github.com/abrignoni/GLEAPP-MapDownloader): companion to GLEAPP that cuts an area of the Protomaps planet basemap into one .pmtiles file for GLEAPP's offline maps, run on a machine with internet access
- [LAVA](https://github.com/leapps-org/LAVA-releases): LEAPP Artifact Viewer App — desktop viewer for exploring reports generated by any LEAPP tool
- [Batch LEAPP](https://github.com/abrignoni/batch-leapp): runs any LEAPP tool across a whole folder of extractions with one report index, SHA-256 manifest, GUI and CLI

## Probes

Standalone single-purpose readers, separate from the LEAPPs: https://leapps.org/probes

- [qnxprobe](https://github.com/abrignoni/qnxprobe): identifies, lists and extracts QNX, Linux, Windows and Apple filesystems and the Linux flash filesystems (SquashFS, JFFS2, UBI/UBIFS, YAFFS) out of raw disk images, flash dumps and forensic containers, opens BitLocker and encrypted APFS volumes with their key, and recovers deleted files from YAFFS2, JFFS2 and UBIFS
- [ewfprobe](https://github.com/abrignoni/ewfprobe): read-only reader for forensic images (E01, Ex01, SMART, AFF, AFF4), Apple disk images, virtual machine disks (VHD, VHDX, VMDK, QCOW) and logical evidence (L01, AD1) that presents the acquired disk as a seekable file; pure Python, no libewf
- [exoprobe](https://github.com/abrignoni/exoprobe): rejoins the media Android apps cached through ExoPlayer, including DASH and HLS streams

## Install

macOS (Homebrew tap: leapps-org/leapps):

    brew trust leapps-org/leapps     # Homebrew 6 will not load a third-party tap until it is trusted; older Homebrew without `brew trust` skips this
    brew tap leapps-org/leapps
    brew install --cask ileapp-gui   # iLEAPP.app plus the `ileapp` command line; same for aleapp-gui, rleapp-gui, vleapp-gui, dleapp-gui
    brew install --cask gleapp       # GLEAPP.app, no command line linked
    brew install --cask lava         # LAVA

iLEAPP, ALEAPP, RLEAPP, VLEAPP and DLEAPP are one program each: no arguments opens the window, arguments run the command line. The `ileapp`, `aleapp`, `rleapp` and `vleapp` formulae are deprecated.

Windows and Linux: pre-built downloads on each tool's GitHub releases page (Windows installer or portable zip, Linux AppImage). From source: Python 3.10+, `pip install -r requirements.txt`, then `python ileapp.py -t <fs|tar|zip|gz|raw> -i <input> -o <output>` (or `aleapp.py`, `rleapp.py`, `vleapp.py`, `dleapp.py`).

## Key pages

- [Releases](https://leapps.org/releases): latest downloads for every tool, with install commands
- [Quick start](https://leapps.org/docs): pick a tool, run an extraction, read the report
- [Artifact search](https://leapps.org/artifacts): searchable index of every artifact parser across the tools
- [Blog](https://leapps.org/blog): artifact research, tool updates, and how-to guides ([RSS](https://leapps-api.4n6-198.workers.dev/blog/feed))
- [Stats](https://leapps.org/stats): live download counts, stars, and contributor data
- [Scoreboard](https://leapps.org/scoreboard): community contributor rankings

## Community

- [GitHub](https://github.com/abrignoni): all repositories; contributions welcome via pull request
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/XaZaknENUR): community chat and support
- [How to write a module](https://leapps.org/blog-post?post=2026-06-14-how-to-write-an-ileapp-module): guide to contributing an artifact parser
